message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"e051","prompts":["帮我看一下我们 org 下 acme-backend 这个 repo 有没有 secret scanning 的 alert，最近有人在代码里贴了个 API key，我担心已经 push 上去了。","新接手一个老项目，我想先 audit 一下安全状况，把 acme/legacy-service 仓库里所有的 secret scanning alerts 都列出来看看。","CI 提示仓库里有 credential 泄露，你能不能把 github 上 acme/payments 这个 repo 的告警列表拉出来，我想知道是哪个 commit 引入的。","我们准备 open source 一个内部工具，发布之前想把 acme/internal-tools 仓库扫一遍，确认没有残留的 token 或者 password 之类的 secret alert。","安全团队要一份报告，麻烦把 acme/platform 仓库当前所有 secret scanning 的 alert 汇总一下，包括状态是 open 还是 resolved 的。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e052","prompts":["I'm setting up automation for our repo and need to see what custom fields exist on issues in acme/platform — especially which ones are dropdowns and what their valid options are.","Before I bulk-import 200 issues into acme/website via the API, show me the issue field definitions for that repo so I know the expected format for each field.","I want to add a new ticket template, but first I need to know what fields are already defined at the organization level for our GitHub issues.","Can you list the issue fields for acme/mobile-app? I'm curious whether there's a date field I can use for tracking release targets.","I'm writing a script that validates issue metadata before submission — pull the field schema (names, types, and select options) for acme/data-pipeline so I can build the validation rules."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e053","prompts":["仓库里有一份旧的配置文件 config_old.json 已经没用了，帮我把 acme/legacy-api 仓库里的这个文件删掉吧。","我之前不小心把一份测试用的临时文件 test_placeholder.md 提交到了 acme/demo 仓库，请帮我删除它。","acme/web-app 仓库根目录下的 README.bak 是冗余的备份文件，麻烦把它从仓库里移除掉。","上次重构后 docs/old_architecture.md 这个文件已经过时了，帮我在 acme/docs-repo 仓库里把它清理掉。","我在 acme/scripts 仓库里看到一个废弃的 deploy_v1.sh，我们已经迁移到新脚本了，请把这个旧文件从仓库删掉。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e054","prompts":["我这边有三份 scanner 的报告 PDF，麻烦帮我 merge 成一个完整的 document 再加个 watermark。","这个 scanned 出来的 PDF 没法搜索，帮我做个 OCR 让里面的文字变成可复制的 text。","帮我把这份 200 页的合同 PDF 拆开，只要第 10 到 25 页，输出一个新的 file。","税表这种 PDF form 里面有好多要填的格子，帮我把姓名、地址和日期这几个 field 填进去。","从这份 PDF 报告里把所有的 table 抽出来，我想在 Excel 里继续分析这些数据。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e055","prompts":["I keep getting flooded with notifications from the acme/legacy-crm repo that I don't even work on anymore — can you set my subscription so I stop hearing from it?","Our team repo acme/notifications-test is generating way too much noise during the migration; unsubscribe me from its notifications for now.","I want to be notified about every change in the new acme/critical-infra repo — can you set my subscription to watch it?","After my earlier changes were reverted, I no longer need updates from acme/experimental — please remove my notification subscription for that repo entirely.","Can you check and manage my notification settings for acme/frontend? I'd like to ignore it while I'm on vacation next week."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e056","prompts":["帮我把 acme/backend 仓库里所有还是 open 状态的 issue 列出来，我需要整理一下这个迭代要处理的内容。","我想看看 acme/frontend 仓库中标签为 bug 的 issue 有哪些，麻烦分页把完整列表拉出来。","acme/mobile 这个仓库的 issue 太多了，帮我列出最近的 50 条，如果还有更多用 endCursor 继续翻页。","准备周会了，请把 acme/platform 仓库里 assignee 是我且未关闭的 issue 全部列出来。","新同事入职，帮我把 acme/onboarding 仓库中的全部 issue 拉个清单，让他了解当前团队正在跟进的事项。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e057","prompts":["帮我把这批扫描件 PDF 全部做 OCR，然后按日期 merge 成一份 searchable 的归档文件。","这个 PDF 里的表格数据我要用，帮我 extract 出来存成 CSV，顺便把前几页的 cover letter 文字也抽出来。","我需要给 500 份合同 PDF 批量加水印并且加密，这种规模的处理你能帮我写个流程跑一遍吗？","季度报告要发给客户，帮我把五个部门的 PDF 报告合并成一个，再把每份的 appendix 拆出来单独存。","这份申请表的 PDF form 需要程序化填写，字段对应的值我都列好了，帮我批量填进去生成新文件。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e058","prompts":["One of the bot accounts left a huge irrelevant comment as a PR review on acme/api-gateway, and it's cluttering the timeline — can you collapse that review body?","A reviewer accidentally pasted their entire terminal output into a PR review on acme/web-tooling; please minimize that review so it doesn't dominate the page.","I submitted a review on acme/infra last week with outdated feedback that I've since retracted — I'd like to hide the body of my own review to avoid confusion.","The spam review on PR #482 in acme/checkout contains broken formatting and links; can you minimize it since I have triage access?","Someone's PR review on acme/analytics contains internal info we shouldn't display prominently — collapse that review body, please."],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e059","prompts":["帮我看一下 acme/backend 仓库里编号 1234 的 pull request，我需要了解这个 PR 的具体改动内容和当前状态。","我想知道 acme/frontend 仓库那个关于登录重构的 PR 现在是什么情况，麻烦把这个 pull request 的详细信息拉出来给我。","acme/mobile 仓库的 PR #872 已经提了好几天了，帮我查一下它的 review 和 merge 状态。","准备做 code review 之前，先帮我把 acme/platform 仓库编号 301 的这个 pull request 的基本信息和描述读出来。","同事说他在 acme/infra 仓库提了一个修复 bug 的 PR，帮我看下这个 pull request 具体改了哪些文件。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e060","prompts":["帮我把这个 meeting_recording.mp4 的开头 30 秒废话剪掉，然后 trim 到只剩正文部分。","我有三段产品 demo 的 video 片段，帮我按顺序 concatenate 成一个完整的 demo.mp4。","这个 2 小时的 webinar 视频太长了，帮我 split 成四个 30 分钟的片段方便上传。","婚礼视频我想只保留交换戒指那一段，帮我从 01:12:30 裁剪到 01:15:00 输出一个 clip。","录制的时候中间有几分钟卡顿的黑屏，帮我把这段 cut 掉，前后两段拼成一个流畅的 mp4。"],"rubric":[]}]}
